tools.name: Machine_GetComponents
tools.description: Read this machine's component names, descriptions, and whether each component has an assigned GameObject. Call before answering machine component questions. Use the returned names exactly.

tools.name: Machine_ShowAnswer
tools.description: Highlight one machine component and display an answer label above it. Call for every component question, including follow-up questions about the same or another component. The previous highlight and label are replaced automatically. Use an exact component identifier returned by Machine_GetComponents. Check the returned highlighted, uiDisplayed, highlightError, and uiError fields before claiming the highlight or label succeeded.

component.description: Exact component identifier returned by Machine_GetComponents, for example Impeller, PumpCasing, or ElectricMotor.

answer.description: A concise plain-text answer to the user's current question, grounded in the component description.

tools.name: Machine_ShowMessage
tools.description: Display a typed spatial message on the machine using the shared icon, color, header, and text card. Use this for alerts, warnings, information, or directional guidance. For component questions that require highlighting, use Machine_ShowAnswer instead. The previous message and highlight are replaced automatically. Check uiDisplayed and uiError before claiming the card appeared.

type.description: Visual message type. Use point_arrow or turn_arrow only when spatial direction is useful.

component.description: Optional exact component identifier from Machine_GetComponents; places the card above that component.

direction.description: Optional direction for the point or turn arrow icon. Defaults to right.

tools.name: Machine_SetScale
tools.description: Increase or decrease the machine's size by multiplying its current scale. Use multiplier above 1 to enlarge and below 1 to reduce.

tools.name: Machine_Rotate
tools.description: Rotate the machine around its world X, Y, or Z axis.

tools.name: Machine_Translate
tools.description: Move the machine in world space by the supplied X, Y, and Z metre offsets.
